description: Test cases with acceptance criteria and traceability.
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data

records.title: Pack usable energy verification
records.conditions: Reference discharge at 25 degC ambient, conditioned pack, standard rate.
records.acceptance_criterion: Usable energy not less than 78.0 kWh

records.title: Pack thermal performance at high ambient sustained load
records.conditions: 40 degC ambient, sustained 130 km/h highway load for 90 minutes, cabin cooling active.
records.acceptance_criterion: No power derate before 75 minutes and maximum cell temperature within the qualified window

records.title: Cell temperature gradient mapping
records.conditions: Instrumented pack, 2C discharge from full, coolant inlet at 25 degC.
records.acceptance_criterion: Maximum cell to cell temperature difference not more than 6 K

records.title: Accelerated battery ageing durability
records.conditions: Cycling schedule representative of the qualified duty mix at elevated temperature.
records.acceptance_criterion: TBD_PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC - equivalent cycle count and retained energy acceptance not established for the revised chemistry

records.title: Pack ingress protection verification
records.conditions: Dust and water ingress exposure per the specified classification after thermal cycling.
records.acceptance_criterion: No ingress beyond the specified classification and isolation resistance maintained

records.title: Pack seal compression set after thermal cycling
records.conditions: Accelerated thermal cycling followed by compression set measurement.
records.acceptance_criterion: Compression set within the qualification limit

records.title: Pack pressure equalisation verification
records.conditions: Altitude and temperature sweep across the specified operating envelope.
records.acceptance_criterion: Internal pressure differential remains within the sealing capability

records.title: Cooling plate heat rejection verification
records.conditions: Defined thermal load applied at specified coolant inlet temperature and flow rate.
records.acceptance_criterion: Heat rejection not less than the specified value

records.title: Cooling plate helium leak test
records.conditions: Helium leak detection at proof pressure after thermal and vibration conditioning.
records.acceptance_criterion: Leak rate below the specified limit with zero failures

records.title: Cooling plate braze coverage sectioning
records.conditions: Sectioning at defined locations and measurement of braze joint coverage.
records.acceptance_criterion: Braze joint coverage not less than the specified minimum with no through-wall porosity

records.title: Cooling plate flatness measurement
records.conditions: Coordinate measurement of plate flatness after braze.
records.acceptance_criterion: Flatness within the specified tolerance

records.title: Leak tester measurement system analysis
records.conditions: Gauge repeatability and reproducibility study using calibrated master leak parts.
records.acceptance_criterion: Measurement system capability adequate for the specified leak rate limit

records.title: Busbar weld tensile and resistance verification
records.conditions: Tensile pull and four-wire resistance measurement on welded busbar joints.
records.acceptance_criterion: Tensile strength and resistance within specified limits

records.title: Pack vibration durability with continuous monitoring
records.conditions: Vibration profile per the environmental specification with continuous cell voltage monitoring.
records.acceptance_criterion: No signal dropout and no mechanical damage

records.title: HV isolation resistance verification
records.conditions: Isolation measurement across the specified environmental conditions.
records.acceptance_criterion: Isolation resistance above the qualified minimum

records.title: HV contactor endurance
records.conditions: Load switching cycles at the specified current and voltage.
records.acceptance_criterion: Specified cycle count completed without welding or degradation beyond limit

records.title: SOC estimation accuracy across temperature
records.conditions: SOC estimation error measured against reference coulomb counting across the qualified temperature and current range.
records.acceptance_criterion: Absolute error not more than 3 percent

records.title: Cell overtemperature protection verification
records.conditions: Controlled cell heating to the protection threshold with monitored response.
records.acceptance_criterion: Protection engages within the specified response time at the defined threshold

records.title: Temperature sensor representativeness verification
records.conditions: Instrumented pack with reference thermocouples at predicted hot spots under worst-case load.
records.acceptance_criterion: Monitored sensor tracks the hottest cell within the specified error

records.title: Cell balancing convergence verification
records.conditions: Induced cell voltage spread balanced over the specified duration.
records.acceptance_criterion: Spread reduced below the convergence limit within the specified duration

records.title: Power limit map verification against cell capability
records.conditions: Reported power limits compared with measured cell capability across temperature and SOC.
records.acceptance_criterion: Reported limits within the specified margin of measured capability

records.title: State of health estimate correlation
records.conditions: Periodic reference capacity measurement compared with the reported state of health.
records.acceptance_criterion: TBD_PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC - correlation acceptance band not established for the revised chemistry

records.title: Concurrent thermal load capability
records.conditions: 40 degC ambient with concurrent maximum cabin cooling demand and sustained high drive load.
records.acceptance_criterion: Battery temperature remains within the operating window for the specified duration

records.title: Thermal arbitration HIL verification
records.conditions: Simulated concurrent demand scenarios exercising the arbitration priority scheme.
records.acceptance_criterion: Arbitration follows the defined priority scheme in all scenarios

records.title: Coolant flow rate verification
records.conditions: Flow measurement at rated pump duty and nominal circuit restriction.
records.acceptance_criterion: Flow rate not less than the specified value

records.title: Diverter valve position fault detection
records.conditions: Induced valve stall with monitored diagnostic response.
records.acceptance_criterion: Fault detected and reported within the specified time

records.title: Thermal derate driver communication
records.conditions: Induced thermal derate with observation of driver information and diagnostic recording.
records.acceptance_criterion: Derate communicated to the driver and recorded in diagnostics

records.title: DC fast charge time at reference conditions
records.conditions: 25 degC ambient, reference DC station, 10 to 80 percent state of charge.
records.acceptance_criterion: Charge time not more than 32 minutes

records.title: DC fast charge time at low ambient
records.conditions: 8 degC ambient soak, reference DC station, 10 to 80 percent state of charge.
records.acceptance_criterion: TBD_PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC - low ambient charge time target not established

records.title: Charge inlet contact temperature characterisation
records.conditions: Sustained maximum current with instrumented inlet contacts at elevated ambient.
records.acceptance_criterion: Contact temperature remains below the specified protection threshold

records.title: Charge current derate ramp verification
records.conditions: Induced derate condition with measurement of current ramp profile.
records.acceptance_criterion: Ramp profile within the defined rate limits

records.title: Charging interoperability campaign
records.conditions: Charging sessions across a representative population of DC charging stations.
records.acceptance_criterion: TBD_PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC - station population coverage and pass rate target not established

records.title: DC charge contactor open state confirmation
records.conditions: Repeated high current interruption followed by open state verification.
records.acceptance_criterion: Open state confirmed on every cycle with no contact welding

records.title: AC charging power verification at temperature
records.conditions: AC charge power measured across the qualified ambient range.
records.acceptance_criterion: Rated 11 kW delivered at nominal supply within the qualified range

records.title: Peak power verification
records.conditions: Peak power from thermally conditioned start state.
records.acceptance_criterion: Specified peak power delivered for the defined duration

records.title: Continuous power on sustained gradient
records.conditions: Sustained gradient climb at maximum permissible mass, 30 degC ambient.
records.acceptance_criterion: Specified continuous power sustained without derate below the target

records.title: Inverter thermal derate onset verification
records.conditions: Controlled thermal ramp with monitored derate onset.
records.acceptance_criterion: Derate initiates at the defined junction temperature threshold

records.title: Unintended torque fault injection
records.conditions: Systematic fault injection across the torque path with monitored safe state response.
records.acceptance_criterion: No unintended torque exceeding the safe limit for any injected fault

records.title: Resolver signal plausibility verification
records.conditions: Induced resolver offset and noise with monitored diagnostic response.
records.acceptance_criterion: Implausible position detected and safe state entered within the specified time

records.title: Motor insulation dielectric verification
records.conditions: Dielectric withstand test after environmental and durability conditioning.
records.acceptance_criterion: No breakdown at the specified test voltage

records.title: Gearbox noise evaluation
records.conditions: Coast and drive sweeps across the speed range with cabin noise measurement.
records.acceptance_criterion: Gear whine below the defined level in the target orders

records.title: Cold performance stopping distance
records.conditions: Cold brake performance runs at the conditions defined by the approval requirement.
records.acceptance_criterion: Stopping distance meets the applicable approval requirement

records.title: Fade and recovery test
records.conditions: Repeated high energy stops followed by recovery stops per the approval procedure.
records.acceptance_criterion: Fade and recovery performance meets the applicable approval requirement

records.title: Friction coefficient characterisation
records.conditions: Friction coefficient measured across the qualified temperature, pressure and speed envelope.
records.acceptance_criterion: Friction coefficient within the specified band across the envelope

records.title: Regenerative blending subjective and objective evaluation
records.conditions: Blending transitions across deceleration rates and compound temperature states.
records.acceptance_criterion: TBD_PROGRAMME_SPECIFIC - objective blending discontinuity limit not established

records.title: Judder durability schedule with thickness variation measurement
records.conditions: Defined judder durability schedule with periodic disc thickness variation measurement.
records.acceptance_criterion: Disc thickness variation below the specified limit throughout the schedule

records.title: Brake noise evaluation schedule
records.conditions: Defined noise evaluation matrix across temperature, humidity and pressure conditions.
records.acceptance_criterion: Noise occurrence rate below the defined limit

records.title: Friction material restricted substance analysis
records.conditions: Laboratory analysis of restricted substance content on production representative samples.
records.acceptance_criterion: Restricted substance content within the permitted level for the target markets

records.title: Friction material density verification
records.conditions: Density measurement on moulded friction material samples.
records.acceptance_criterion: Density within the specified range

records.title: Suspension rig durability
records.conditions: Load spectrum representative of the vehicle durability schedule applied on a rig.
records.acceptance_criterion: No crack initiation or loss of function at the completion of the schedule

records.title: Control arm bushing radial stiffness measurement
records.conditions: Radial stiffness measured at reference temperature and preload.
records.acceptance_criterion: Radial stiffness within the specified tolerance band

records.title: Bushing press-fit process capability study
records.conditions: Press force and final position recorded across consecutive production.
records.acceptance_criterion: Process capability index meets the specified minimum on both characteristics

records.title: Bushing retention under load
records.conditions: Axial and radial load applied with displacement measurement.
records.acceptance_criterion: No displacement beyond the specified limit

records.title: Ride comfort evaluation on reference surfaces
records.conditions: Vertical acceleration measurement on the defined reference road surfaces.
records.acceptance_criterion: Vertical ride acceleration below the defined comfort target

records.title: Road noise transfer path measurement
records.conditions: Structure-borne transfer path measurement on coarse surfaces.
records.acceptance_criterion: Transferred level below the defined limit in the specified frequency bands

records.title: Handling stability at maximum mass
records.conditions: Defined handling manoeuvres at maximum permissible mass and load distribution.
records.acceptance_criterion: Handling stability targets met in all manoeuvres

records.title: Steering assist loss safe state verification
records.conditions: Fault injection across the assist path with monitored safe state entry.
records.acceptance_criterion: Defined safe state entered with manual steerability retained for every injected fault

records.title: Steering ECU diagnostic coverage verification
records.conditions: Safety analysis and fault injection on the target processing element.
records.acceptance_criterion: Diagnostic coverage meets the allocated safety integrity requirement

records.title: Steering assist response time measurement
records.conditions: Step and sweep driver torque input with assist torque response measurement.
records.acceptance_criterion: Response within the specified time constant

records.title: Steering approval verification
records.conditions: Steering behaviour assessment per the applicable approval requirement.
records.acceptance_criterion: Compliance with the applicable steering approval requirement

records.title: Full vehicle radiated emissions measurement
records.conditions: Chamber measurement across the required frequency range in drive and DC charge modes.
records.acceptance_criterion: Emissions within the applicable approval limits in all modes

records.title: Full vehicle radiated immunity measurement
records.conditions: Chamber exposure at the applicable field strengths with function monitoring.
records.acceptance_criterion: All monitored functions remain within the defined performance criteria

records.title: HV harness shield continuity measurement
records.conditions: Termination to termination impedance measurement along the routing path.
records.acceptance_criterion: Impedance below the specified limit at every termination

records.title: HV harness routing verification against the standard
records.conditions: Physical build routing compared with the released routing standard.
records.acceptance_criterion: Minimum separation from sensitive circuits maintained along the full path

records.title: Bus load measurement on the integration bench
records.conditions: Bus utilisation measured under worst-case message loading.
records.acceptance_criterion: Utilisation below the defined maximum

records.title: Diagnostic service coverage verification
records.conditions: Diagnostic service requests exercised across all safety and emissions relevant functions.
records.acceptance_criterion: All required services supported with correct responses

records.title: Cybersecurity penetration testing on external interfaces
records.conditions: Structured penetration testing on the identified attack surfaces.
records.acceptance_criterion: No unmitigated finding above the defined risk acceptance level

records.title: LV conducted transient immunity
records.conditions: Conducted transient pulses applied on supply lines with function monitoring.
records.acceptance_criterion: No loss of function at the specified severity level

records.title: Cabin cool-down time measurement
records.conditions: Hot soak at the specified condition followed by cool-down to the target temperature.
records.acceptance_criterion: Cool-down achieved within the defined time

records.title: HVAC energy consumption over the reference climate cycle
records.conditions: Energy consumption measured over the reference climate cycle.
records.acceptance_criterion: Consumption within the allocated energy budget

records.title: Compressor operating envelope verification
records.conditions: Operation swept across the specified pressure and speed envelope.
records.acceptance_criterion: No protective shutdown across the envelope

records.title: Compressor cabin noise measurement
records.conditions: Cabin noise measured across compressor speed at stationary and driving conditions.
records.acceptance_criterion: Cabin noise below the defined level at every operating point

records.title: Calibration identifier readback verification
records.conditions: Diagnostic readback of the active calibration identifier.
records.acceptance_criterion: Active calibration identifier readable and matching the build record

records.title: Update interruption and rollback verification
records.conditions: Update interrupted at defined points with monitored rollback behaviour.
records.acceptance_criterion: Previous approved state restored on every interruption point

records.title: Range estimate accuracy on the reference cycle
records.conditions: Displayed range compared with achieved range over the reference cycle at multiple ambients.
records.acceptance_criterion: Range estimate error within the defined band

records.title: Configuration control audit
records.conditions: Audit of calibration release and plant application against the configuration control procedure.
records.acceptance_criterion: No major non-conformance against the procedure

records.title: Tyre rolling resistance measurement
records.conditions: Rolling resistance measured on the specified test drum condition.
records.acceptance_criterion: Rolling resistance within the vehicle energy budget allocation

records.title: Pass-by noise measurement with fitted tyre
records.conditions: Pass-by noise measured on the specified test surface per the approval procedure.
records.acceptance_criterion: Sound emission within the applicable approval limits

records.title: Axle load and tyre load index verification
records.conditions: Axle load measurement at maximum permissible mass with load index comparison.
records.acceptance_criterion: Tyre load capability meets or exceeds measured maximum axle load

records.title: Wheel and tyre assembly mass measurement
records.conditions: Mass measurement of the complete wheel and tyre assembly.
records.acceptance_criterion: Assembly mass within the unsprung mass allocation

records.title: Vehicle certified range measurement
records.conditions: Range measurement over the applicable light-duty test procedure.
records.acceptance_criterion: Certified combined range not less than 490 km

records.title: Vehicle kerb mass measurement
records.conditions: Kerb mass measurement in the specified configuration.
records.acceptance_criterion: Kerb mass not more than 2100 kg

records.title: LV supply worst case load verification
records.conditions: Simultaneous peak demand from steering, braking and thermal systems.
records.acceptance_criterion: Supply voltage remains within the specified band for all safety relevant loads

records.title: DC-DC converter output at temperature
records.conditions: Rated output measured across the qualified HV input and thermal range.
records.acceptance_criterion: Rated output delivered across the qualified range

records.title: Tailpipe emissions over the required test procedures
records.conditions: Emissions measured over the required test procedures on the applicable configuration.
records.acceptance_criterion: Emissions within the applicable approval limits

records.title: Cold start light-off characterisation
records.conditions: Cold start emissions measurement with catalyst temperature instrumentation.
records.acceptance_criterion: Effective conversion reached within the defined time

records.title: Aged catalyst emissions verification
records.conditions: Emissions measurement on catalyst samples aged to the required durability equivalent.
records.acceptance_criterion: Emissions within the applicable limits on aged parts

records.title: OBD catalyst monitor demonstration
records.conditions: Demonstration using threshold catalyst parts.
records.acceptance_criterion: Monitor correctly distinguishes threshold and compliant parts

records.title: Frontal impact occupant protection
records.conditions: Frontal impact per the applicable approval procedure.
records.acceptance_criterion: Occupant injury criteria within the applicable approval limits

records.title: Restraint inadvertent deployment verification
records.conditions: Non-crash stimulus matrix with monitored deployment outputs.
records.acceptance_criterion: No deployment for any non-crash stimulus

records.title: Radar detection range and accuracy verification
records.conditions: Detection range and angular accuracy measured across the qualified environmental envelope.
records.acceptance_criterion: Detection range and accuracy within specification

records.title: Perception degradation behaviour verification
records.conditions: Adverse condition exposure with monitored function degradation and driver communication.
records.acceptance_criterion: Degradation follows the defined and communicated behaviour

records.title: Pack end of line pressure decay test
records.conditions: Pressure decay measurement on every assembled pack.
records.acceptance_criterion: Decay rate below the specified limit with zero failures

records.title: Enclosure fastener torque and angle monitoring
records.conditions: Torque and angle recorded for every enclosure fastener.
records.acceptance_criterion: Torque and angle within specification for every fastener

records.title: Pack capacity correlation to laboratory measurement
records.conditions: End of line capacity measurement correlated against laboratory reference.
records.acceptance_criterion: Correlation within the specified error band

records.title: Thermal interface material coverage vision inspection
records.conditions: Vision inspection of the applied thermal interface bead.
records.acceptance_criterion: Coverage within the specified pattern on every module

records.title: Power module thermal resistance verification
records.conditions: Thermal resistance measured after module attach.
records.acceptance_criterion: Thermal resistance below the specified limit

records.title: Catalyst canning force monitoring
records.conditions: Canning force recorded for every part.
records.acceptance_criterion: Canning force within the specified window for every part
